fields.title: Write a Python Program to Find the Special Product
fields.description:
Problem Statement

Write a function solve(*args) that accepts a variable number of integer arguments and returns a result based on the following rules:
       
   --> If only one argument is provided, return its square. 
   
   --> If exactly two arguments are provided, return their product.
    
    -->  If more than two arguments are provided, return the product of all positive numbers only. 
  
     -->If there are no positive numbers when more than two arguments are provided, return 0.
